items.text: So... The game sucks you in. But man it's grindy. To get anywhere You will have to spend so many hours... Even the sleep takes forever. It's like if You had taken Your life 1 to 1 and added a bunch of interface to traverse. Even Starfield is much less grindy than this. I can't recommend this game to anyone that has a tiniest bit of a respect for his time.
items.text_zh: 所以……这个游戏会把你吸进去。但天哪，它太肝了。想到达任何地方，你都得花上那么多小时……连睡觉都要花 forever。就像你把自己的生活1比1搬进去，还加了一大堆界面来穿行。就连Starfield也比这个肝少得多。我无法向任何对自己时间有一丁点尊重的人推荐这个游戏。

observations.evidence_zh: 就连睡觉都要花上永远那么久
